All verification suites pass. Final summary of the work:

**Submission (`/workspace/submission`, 8 entries, ~37 KB):**

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `cli.py` | Standalone UTF-8 entry: strict parse (duplicate keys at any depth, nonfinite incl. `1e999`, trailing JSON, bad UTF-8 → exactly `{"error":"invalid"}`), single-line response, flushed `os._exit(0)`, empty stderr |
| `validate.py` | Schema checks + the published whole-batch bounds (runs, expanded ops, enqueues, save names), command normalization |
| `utils.py` | **Completed experiment adapter**: replays each command array, emits every log row (including automatic sample rows after the triggering enqueue), owns the never-rewinding checkpoint registry |
| `scheduler.py` | Staged interleaved branchable scheduler: fixed cyclic visits (idle ticks counted), head-service-then-refill vs. refill-then-service, byte-capped FIFO/PIFO, prefix-retaining pushout in descending order, `min(rank,U-1)` classification, staggered dispatch counters, sampling normalization + history decay, conservative floor-formula repartition, save/restore, final certificate |
| `algorithms.py` | `fifo`/`sp`/`sff`/`wfq` ranks in exact integer arithmetic (`ceil(len*2^20/w)`), service feedback only on successful pops, copy-on-write table snapshots, exact certificates |
| `packet.py` | Immutable id/ordinal/rank plus per-packet lag baselines |
| `sortedcontainers/__init__.py` | Baseline `SortedList` plus segmented copy-on-write stores (`FifoStore`, `PifoStore`, `RankIndex`, `LiveIndex`) and `RankCounter` |
| `README.md` | Design/invariant notes |

**Key engineering decisions** (large backlogs + frequent branches): live lag is two prefix sums over a served-rank multiset instead of backlog sweeps; `rank_error` is one prefix count over the global `(rank,ordinal)` live index; refill pushout walks only the merged tail it actually evicts; checkpoints copy short segment tables (immutable segment tuples) so save/restore are sublinear and branches are fully isolated; cancellation is O(log n) in both stages.

**Validation performed:** `python3 check.py submission` (9 children pass); ~1300 differential cases against an independently written naive reference across four generator profiles — zero mismatches; 13 hand-computed edge cases (dispatch stagger, rejection, idle pushout, suffix pushout, cross-stage lag, sampling bias, auto-sampling, repartition, cancellation, WFQ weights); branch-isolation and save-overwrite tests; a ~60-case malformed-input battery; exactness beyond 2⁵³; and worst-case timing at the published bounds (100 000 ops / 60 000 enqueues / 8 runs / 16×8×64 counters): **3.8 s CPU, 78 MiB RSS, 5.5 MiB stdout**.
